name: Raikyo Phoenix Dancong Oolong Craft Sake

producer.name: Akiu Heart Rock Sake
producer.native: 秋保ハートロックサケ
producer.about: Akiu Heart Rock Sake is a craft sake company based in Sendai, Miyagi. Its labels carry a heart-shaped mark, and its neck tag says the sake is fermented with other ingredients together with the rice from the very beginning. The Raikyo line is brewed with Phoenix Dancong oolong tea from a Hong Kong tea house.
